 LYFE Capital to acquire Korea’s cosmeceutical firm for up to $147 mn amid K-beauty boom
 Its acquisition of Medians adds to a wave of foreign investment in K-beauty, as healthcare investors target clinic-focused brands with high margins and steady growth
 (Screenshot from the official website of Ahohwa, a Medians brand) 
 3 
 2026-11-08 18:25:53
 Beauty & Cosmetics 
LYFE Capital, a global healthcare-focused private equity and venture capital firm, is set to acquire Medians Co., a South Korean cosmeceutical manufacturer, for up to $147 million, investment banking sources in Seoul said on Sunday.
